# Desktop and web UI routes. Generated by packages/client-ui/scripts/interface-listing.mjs; do not edit.
# Run `pnpm interfaces` after changing them. Each address is `#` followed by the route. {server} is the hub's server ID, and
# {account}, {thread} and {message} are account, conversation and message IDs; each is URL-encoded.
# Format: ITEM | ATTRIBUTES | DESCRIPTION
route /servers | - | Saved hubs in the desktop app, or the hub picker in a browser.
route /{server}/accounts | params server | The accounts on a hub, where you sign in, add or manage one.
route /{server}/{account}/chats | params server, account | The chat list of an account.
route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread} | params server, account, thread | One conversation.
route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}/info | params server, account, thread | Conversation details, including group settings for a group chat.
route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}/media/{message} | params server, account, thread, message | The photo and video viewer, opened on one message of a conversation.
route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}/message/{message} | params server, account, thread, message | A conversation scrolled to one message, which is highlighted.
route /{server}/{account}/contacts | params server, account | The contact list of an account.
route /{server}/{account}/login | params server, account | Sign in to one account with a QR code.
route /{server}/{account}/mini-programs | params server, account | Mini Programs and package availability for the selected account.
route /{server}/{account}/new-chat | params server, account | The dialog for starting a conversation or creating a group.
route /{server}/{account}/settings | params server, account | Settings for the app, the hub and the account.
